svg.title: PRISMA-style filtering of TIER_1_HIGH down to the prioritized review list
svg.desc: Flow diagram showing how 1,017 papers in TIER_1_HIGH were narrowed to 31 Priority A and 14 Priority B papers through provenance splitting and abstract-based relevance screening.
